summary: Verified sample-order checkout UX: Free sample lines render 'Free' (not Rp 0) at Step 1, Step 3 line total, Subtotal (bruto) and Grand Total; Berbayar still shows Rupiah; sample delivery choice (sample-delivery-choice) renders in Step 3 with Disesuaikan Admin Sampel default (no date picker, correct hint); Pilih tanggal reveals delivery-date-input and switches hint; switching back to admin clears date; submit with default (no date) creates SOS-00001 successfully; regular (non-sample) checkout renders delivery-date-input directly (no sample-delivery-choice).
critical_code_review_comments: CheckoutStep3.jsx:18 — local useState pickDate persists across re-renders of Step3 but is RESET to initial !!deliveryDate on each remount. Since Step3 unmounts on step change, going Step3 → Step2 → Step3 with pickDate=true but deliveryDate='' would reset to admin mode. Not a blocker for current flow (admin→pick→admin clears deliveryDate; pick→back→next re-mounts with deliveryDate present if user set one, so pickDate re-initialises true). Fine.
CheckoutDrawer.jsx:186 — delivery_date is sent only when fulfillment_method='kirim'. For sample 'Disesuaikan Admin Sampel' this correctly submits '' (server stored delivery_date=''). ✅
